title: Add an explicit schema resolver resource kind
api_or_output: Add XmlResourceKind.Schema = 5 without changing existing values, requests, resolver or resource ownership

acceptance.description: Implement the frozen additive Schema resource kind, preserving the exact existing enum values and resolver API/ownership semantics.

Verify callers can discriminate schema requests from external entities and includes; check synchronous/asynchronous request forwarding and unchanged resource disposal behavior. Replace only the inherited undefined-kind input 5 with 6 because 5 becomes defined; retain all other undefined-kind checks and record that intentional test identity transition for the cumulative gate.

Verify exact additive public API baseline and focused earlier resolver/resource-kind regressions against the integrated prerequisites; record actual revision, checks and ownership. No runtime matching or allocation optimization is introduced.
